title: Grande oportunidade para Administrador(a) de Contratos, Orçamento e Custos
description:
CONTRACTS, BUDGET & COST ADMINISTRATOR

Departamento: QHSE
Reporta a: HSE Manager
Localização: Angola

Job Summary

Ensure HSE contracts are in conformance with company contracting process and procedures, and that the spend is managed in alignment with the contracts. Ensure the integrity, accessibility, and compliance of HSE contract documentation and cost-related information across HSE Department. Ensure HSE annual budget is developed and managed in alignment with budget cycle and that it integrates the input from all functions within HSE.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contract Management
  • Procurement & Documentation
  • Contractor Performance Management
  • Budget & Cost Control
  • Financial Monitoring & Reporting
  • Budget Planning
  • Operational Coordination

Qualifications & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of procurement systems such as SAP platform, EXCEL, Outlook proficiency.
  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in accounting, administration, management, or related field.
  • At least 5 – 7 years of experience.

Requirements

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent organisational and document management skills.
  • Strong analytical and financial management capabilities.
  • Attention to detail and compliance awareness.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple contractors and manage competing priorities.
  • Fluent English Speaker.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume/CV in English using the subject title “CONTRACTS, BUDGET & COST ADMINISTRATOR”.

Email: recrutamentovoefx@gmail.com

Additional Information

  • Only pre-selected candidates will be contacted.
  • Thank you to all applicants for your interest.
Passos para se inscrever:

Faça a sua candidatura através do e-mail: recrutamentovoefx@gmail.com

Partilhar: Verifique o seu CV

Carregue o seu CV e veja como ele se compara com esta vaga. É gratuito, não precisa de conta e o ficheiro não é guardado.
